context: Evaluates whether the model uses EventsOn to register persistent event listeners and EventsOff to remove them, including support for removing multiple event names in a single call. The key challenge is knowing that EventsOn returns a cancel function and that EventsOff accepts variadic event name arguments.

checklist.name: EventsOn for subscribe
checklist.description: EventsOn from @wailsapp/runtime is called with the eventName and handler when subscribe is invoked

checklist.name: Cancel function returned
checklist.description: subscribe returns the cancel function that EventsOn itself returns, enabling the caller to remove the specific listener

checklist.name: EventsOff for unsubscribe
checklist.description: EventsOff from @wailsapp/runtime is called when unsubscribe is invoked

checklist.name: Variadic EventsOff args
checklist.description: All event name arguments (the primary name and any additional names) are spread and forwarded to EventsOff in a single call
